author: Murphh
body:
Hi ya - I'd like some commands that everyone can use to find out more team info instead of having to check the website.  I don't know if any of these exist or something like it, but I would like these.
Thanks for considering this suggestion!!

/teamlist

would give you a list of all the team names

/teamlist [teamname]

would give you a list of all the players on that team

/msg team [teamname]
would send a message to all team members

/r would then reply to all team members

If anyone knows of any team commands for members (not leaders) that are available now, please let me know.
Thanks! <3

replies.author: Murphh
replies.body:
Thanks for the feedback!
Before when I said 'team', I meant 'tourney team'.   And now when I say 'regular match', I mean non-scrim or non-tourney match.

I meant this command /teamlist to function like /stafflist during a regular match where you could see -
1) if players from a tourney team are online and
2) what server they are on

This would be helpful for organizing set scrims or impromptu scrims for tourney teams.

Also, I would like a tag added, so when you do /list during a regular nebula game you can see who the players are who are on a tourney team.

So my tag might look like this ---->  Gold : Murph_the_cat [Nero]

This could be helpful during a regular match when a color team is pushing hard and I'm wondering why they seem so organized. 

I know the information regarding tourney teams is on the website, but it would be easier to access info in game, IMO.
